text:
andrew: Heads up — after the inbound-bridge deploy we’re seeing cross-workspace reads. Noticed requests from workspace `W-349` returning objects owned by `W-12`.
maria: Which deploy/PR? link? :eyes:
andrew: PR #432 (bridge:affinity-fallback). Deployed 2610100900. Quick log snippet:
```
authz: allow user=svc-bridge workspace=W-12 request.tenant=W-349 mapping=DEFAULT_WORKSPACE
```
andrew: The mapping shows DEFAULT_WORKSPACE returned even though tenant header present.
kyle: Rolling back the bridge deploy now. Starting rollback to 432-prev. Will post status.
sec-oncall: :rotating_light: Marking this Sev2. Creating incident channel #inc-2610101010. Action items: 1) rollback (in progress), 2) collect audit traces, 3) rotate bridge service creds/KMS envelope if keys were used across tenants.
deploy-bot: rollback started by @kyle at 2610101100 — step 1/3: terminating new pods
nora: Quick triage of audit logs: I ran a query for `mapping=DEFAULT_WORKSPACE` and found ~27 requests from 4 distinct external orgs in the 15m after the deploy. Example entry:
```
_ts=2610100952 principal=svc-bridge tenant_header=W-349 principal_workspace=null mapping=DEFAULT_WORKSPACE path=/projects/12/data read=true
```
nora: It looks like the tenant-to-workspace mapper returned null then hit a fallback that returns the literal default workspace id. BUG: code returns default instead of rejecting when header is malformed.
maria: Can you paste the mapper code? I remember a change to handle legacy headers.
nora: snippet:
```
function mapTenantToWorkspace(tenant) {
  if (!tenant) return DEFAULT_WORKSPACE; // <- bad: should throw/deny
  return lookup(tenant);
}
```
kyle: That explains it. Patch incoming. I'll revoke active session tokens used by svc-bridge and rotate the KMS envelope key for that service. Any sensitive kms decrypt logs?
andrew: KMS logs show unwrapping by svc-bridge at 2610100960 and 2610100988 for two requests. No other services. No obvious `Decrypt` failures.
sec-oncall: Rotate envelope keys now. Also add short-lived binding for bridge service role so previous envelope keys cannot be used across tenants. We should assume possible read exposure until keys rotated.
maria: Query to find affected tenants (run in Kibana/ES):

```
index: audit-requests
query: mapping:DEFAULT_WORKSPACE AND service:svc-bridge AND @timestamp:[2610100900 TO 2610101100]
```

maria: Will run and DM results to legal + customer success for notices where needed.
kyle: PR with fix: #436 — change fallback to `throw new AuthzError('missing-tenant')` and add unit + e2e. Pushed but holding deploy until keys rotated.
andrew: Thanks. Also add guard in proxy to reject requests missing tenant header (drop, 400) instead of letting mapper see null.
nora: Agreed. I'll follow up with a small proxy patch and a test that simulates malformed header (unicode, empty string).
sec-oncall: Current impact summary: rollback succeeded at 2610101300. Preliminary affected orgs: 4 (no lateral writes observed, only read ops). No evidence of exfil beyond single-object reads. Next: rotate KMS envelope, revoke sessions, run full audit across 24h, notify customers as needed.
maria: I'll start the customer notification draft and coordinate with legal. Tagging @legal. Also increasing audit retention to 90 days for this service.
kyle: Done: revoked bridge sessions, rotated envelope key, and reissued short-lived creds. Holding new deploy until proxy + mapper fix land and tests pass.
andrew: I pushed a smaller hotfix to mapper branch (branch/mapper-hard-fail). Added regression test that would have caught this.
sec-oncall: Followups assigned: mapper hard-fail (nora), proxy guard (nora), rotate kms binding to tenant-scoped role (kyle), audit retention bump (maria). Incident channel created; will add timeline.
maria: Thanks everyone. Would like a quick postmortem once incident closed. :lock:
deploy-bot: rollback completed at 2610101300 — pods restored to previous replica set.
andrew: Closing loop — no further anomalous activity after key rotation and rollback. Please add the regression test to CI gate before future bridge deploys.
